title: The Case of the Vanishing Pudding

characters.name: Inspector Hartley
characters.role: A detective who never misses a crumb

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Good evening, honoured guests. Dinner is served, but I regret to say the pudding has vanished.

steps.speaker: cook
steps.text: I left it on the windowsill to cool, and now there is nothing but an empty dish!

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: The inspector steps forward and studies the windowsill.
steps.screenText: {guest:inspector}, you step forward and study the windowsill.

steps.title: Sticky Footprints
steps.text: A trail of small, sticky footprints leads from the windowsill to the garden door.

steps.speaker: inspector
steps.text: Sticky footprints, and far too small to be any of ours. Most curious.

steps.prompt: Talk it over: who, or what, could have taken the pudding?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: The dice are still. And look, honoured guests: the garden cat is asleep by the door, with custard on its whiskers.
